description: This file contains React components and utility functions for handling links, navigation, and URL parameters within the HTML reporter of Playwright. It includes components for links, project links, attachment links, trace links, and URL parameter management, as well as navigation and anchor handling functions.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: React component that conditionally renders children based on a predicate applied to URL search parameters.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: React component representing a styled clickable link that handles navigation on click.

classes.name: LinkBadge
classes.description: Styled badge component that wraps the Link component.

classes.name: ProjectLink
classes.description: Component that creates a link to filter by project name.

classes.name: AttachmentLink
classes.description: Component that renders a link or expandable view for a test attachment.

classes.name: TraceLink
classes.description: Component that renders a link to view trace attachments for a test.

classes.name: SearchParamsProvider
classes.description: Context provider for URL search parameters, updating on popstate events.

classes.name: Anchor
classes.description: Component that scrolls into view when anchored via URL parameters.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Updates browser history and dispatches a popstate event to navigate to a new URL.

methods.name: useSearchParams
methods.description: React hook to access URL search parameters from context.

methods.name: generateTraceUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for trace attachments.

methods.name: downloadFileNameForAttachment
methods.description: Creates a filename for downloading an attachment.

methods.name: useAnchor
methods.description: Hook that triggers a callback when an element is anchored via URL.

methods.name: useIsAnchored
methods.description: Checks if a given ID is currently anchored in URL parameters.

methods.name: testResultHref
methods.description: Constructs a URL hash for a specific test result and optional anchor.
